'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Cory Degroot DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cory Degroot]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Corey DeGroot
* '''Deck name:''' ROPs
* '''Username:''' OOt
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
